Variants.Content: Salt Farm Town is located in the eastern part of the Riverlands and along the coast of Crab Bay. It is a small port connecting the lower reaches of the Trident, the King's Land and the Vale Sea Road. It legally belongs to the Riverlands and relies on salt industry, fishing, ferries and markets to survive; the lack of solid defense during war makes it more vulnerable to looting than large castles.

Entry Saltpans Local families also relied on river transportation, ferries, wheat fields, mills, and hiding places when war came; if any road, well, spring, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Saltpans They also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the Riverlands; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hooves.

Entry Saltpans If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Saltpans A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Saltpans They care about river transportation, ferries, wheat fields, mills, and hiding places when war comes. They also care about whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
